rationale: D4.1: The incumbent (pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, no region or temporal edit) is retained because no permitted edit has a defensible expected advantage over it under the affinity-first objective. The strongest endpoint contrasts are pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 (endpoint_effects:9,10; adjusted q=0.081/0.077 and 0.019/0.046, same-sign batch fraction 0.79-0.93) and landmark_00_occupancy3 (endpoint_effects:15, q=2.4e-4), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) maps onto those observables. D1.1/D1.2: The only operative reward edit available is the pointcloud curvature delta and the teacher/region selection; the Analyst's H1/H2 observables are diagnostic, not terms the formula contains, so treating them as independent forces would be unsupported. D4.2: The predicted failure response is that any edit would displace surrounding coordinates without a validated affinity benefit: the joint innovation/internal RMS contrasts are significant but negative-signed (branch_adjusted:228,230,305,307) and shape_yy is an opposing direction (branch_adjusted:158,235), so a single favorable axis cannot be assembled; the curve_support audit rejects all 24 candidate curves and every continuous row has extrapolation_allowed=false, so no time-conditioned teacher blend is validated. Temperatures remain fixed (fixed_parameters; teacher_modes temperature_edits=false). Retaining the incumbent is the evidence-supported choice; the decision would change only if a permitted edit were shown to move the executing pointcloud scalar in the direction of the surviving endpoint contrasts without reversing the joint innovation/internal RMS contrast.
